author: jeewon
expect: each guide board should rank at or near the top of what the engine finds from its starting hand

boards.name: Lukias / Ketu + 1
boards.notes:
(All combos that set Sting as the 2nd trap can also set Horn, depending on meta calls.)

Low to the ground, but play safe under Fuwa. Look for any higher ceiling lines that goes into Verte if possible.

if Ketu is your only play, in theory you should search Mululu to play around Droll. But Mululu 1cc has a much lower ceiling than your other starters, so you can take a risk and search Lukias (or Faimena in better hands) instead.

boards.name: Mululu + 1
boards.notes: Ketu for Mululu plays around Droll, but is very low ceiling if you have no other Dtail in hand.

boards.name: Branded Fusion
boards.notes:
Branded Fusion is our only 1cc, but it's one of the few combos that Droll will stop dead in its track. You can play around Droll by having 1 Dtail name in hand.

When you Lenatus away your Walbaz to play around Spoly into Dogma Dragon, you can optionally also Spoly away your Ecclesia (tag out into Albaz) for more cards in hand, and/or Secreterion (so a mirror can't use him to make their own Secreterion) if you value Spoly safety over the floodgate.

boards.name: Fallen of the White Dragon
boards.notes: This does not involve any Dracotail cards but is part of a Branded Dracotail Spreadsheet which is why it is categorized as Dracotail.

boards.name: Fallen of the White Dragon vs Handtrap
gy: The Dragon that Devours the Dogma

boards.name: Walbaz (NS) + Dtail + 1
boards.notes:
(For all Walbaz combos: All lines should play around Lenatus'd in the mirror and Spoly. Standard endboard - Gulamel + ED Ecclesia + Mirrorjade/Sanctifire - plays around these cards, any other monsters you put onto the field risks exposing your boards to Spoly)

NS Walbaz starter is the most high risk - high reward line: High ceiling, but  run head first into handtraps, especially Fuwa.

Generally, only NS Walbaz if it is your only play. Safer lines into Fuwa (like Faimena start) should be prioritized if possible.

boards.name: Walbaz (NS) + Dtail + 1 (2 Albion push)
boards.notes: If you run 2 Albion you can push even further into the Branded direction by sacrificing Dtail plays to get both Mirrorjade and Rindbrumm out on Turn 1.

boards.name: Walbaz + Cartesia
boards.notes: Walbaz + Cartesia can still end on a halfboard with no Dtail Name in hand.

boards.name: Walbaz (SS) + Lukias / Ketu
boards.notes: Special Summoning Walbaz will lock you out of Verte, but it's a much safer play against Fuwa.

boards.name: Fallen of the White Dragon + Lv4
Walbaz (SS) + Urgula/Pan + 1
boards.notes:
This combo uses both of your Arthalion, and is not very good.

If Walbaz is your only play and you want to still have an FnV in the case he is disrupted, you *can* consider SS Walbaz.

I recommend taking the gamble and just NS  him instead.

boards.name: Walbaz + live Faimena
boards.notes:
A common hand you'll likely see very often. With multiple starter options comes MANY branching paths. I cannot possibly go through every one of them, so this combo specifically will only go through the main line.

Note: If you started with Ketu searching for Faimena you can't do this line,  you should refer to the **anti droll** variant of this combo instead.

Main differences between the NS  choice:

NS Lukias:

- Access to FnV

- Doesn't go through the Rahu chokepoint to set traps.

NS Walbaz:

- Ends on Gulamel

- Endboard isn't affected if Arthalion is negated

- Play through  droll

- Endboard doesn't play into Spoly, even when extending for 3 traps

boards.name: Lukias + Faimena / Urgula / Ketu
boards.notes: Lukias + Faimena or Urgula into Little Knight or Mirrorjade

boards.name: Lukias  + Dtail + 1
boards.notes:
This is the basic shape of a hand that can access Verte: A NS plus a fusion that doesn't use up your NS-ed monster as material.

Verte is our strongest card, we **almost always** go for Verte if our hand has the option to.

If you are not playing Branded (or any variant that makes use of Verte) you can instead link Lukias into the Blue-Eyes link 1 and it + Arthalion into Hieratic Seal.
